welcome.label: Welcome · the jetty light

parts.label: 📄 Notice to Mariners
parts.title: Jetty light out
rows: Boats use it to find the harbor

welcome.script:
(Turn a lamp on, then unplug it.) Click. No energy in, no light out.

[ON SCREEN: Notice to Mariners]
But the light at the end of the Palmetto Beach jetty has no plug at all. And three nights ago, it went dark.

[ON SCREEN: A real solar harbor light]
Here’s a real one. See the little square on top? Keep your eye on that. Open the case file just below me and read the keeper’s ticket.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · the black box (Clue 1)

parts.label: 📦 The black box
parts.title: What’s inside?
rows: Drag the device onto the box

warmup.script:
(Hold up a closed box and shake it.) I can’t see inside. But I can see what goes in, and what comes out.

[ON SCREEN: The black box]
That’s a black box. Read each box’s IN and OUT, then drag the device that fits onto it.

[ON SCREEN: Box A, opened]
Here’s one opened up. Look at those glowing wires! Press Listen on Sam’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

part1.label: Part 1 · flip the arrow tag (Clue 2)
part1.script:
(Roll a ball to the camera, then rub your hands fast.) The ball passed its motion along. My hands turned motion into heat.

[ON SCREEN: Moves or changes?]
One MOVES, one CHANGES. Tag every arrow, then press Check my tags. Watch the colors!

part2.label: Part 2 · the energy pipes (Clue 3)

parts.label: 💡 Old bulb vs. LED
parts.title: Same light?
parts.body: Which one sends more energy out as heat?

part2.script:
Here’s a riddle. Can a device use up energy? Can it make new energy?

[ON SCREEN: The energy pipes]
Guess first: how many of the 10 units will come out useful? Then pour, and count both pipes.

[ON SCREEN: Old bulb vs. LED]
Try the old bulb, then the LED. One of them gets really hot. Press Listen.

explore.label: Part 3 · back to the Sun (Clue 4)

parts.label: ☀️ Follow it back
parts.title: Where did the energy come from?
rows: Take one step back at a time

explore.script:
(Hold up a piece of toast.) This toast is warm. Where did that heat come from? The toaster. And before that?

[ON SCREEN: Follow it back]
Follow the energy backward, one step at a time, until you can’t go back any further.

[ON SCREEN: Sun to panel to light]
Then try another device. Look at where every trail starts. Press Listen.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: Why did the light go dark?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues.

parts.label: 🧾 The repair ticket
parts.title: Find the broken link
parts.body: Tap the broken link, pick the fix, stamp it FIXED.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You have four clues. Crack the case at the top of this tab.

[ON SCREEN: The repair ticket]
Then be the engineer: find the broken link in the light’s chain and stamp the ticket FIXED.

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Last, two short answers, your device energy map with a labeled sketch, and your CER.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “A toaster CREATES heat energy. The heat wasn’t there before.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The claim]
Creates heat? Out of nothing? Hmm. Unplug a toaster and see how much toast you make.

There’s no wrong side, as long as you prove it.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts, then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…” Press Listen.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 🪶 Your specimen
parts.title: A pelican feather
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ⚓ Light the harbor
parts.title: Can you get 9 stars?
parts.body: Pick the best device for three night jobs.

parts.label: ➡ Next time
parts.title: You design a device
parts.body: Light with no battery and no plug. How would you build it?

closing.script:
(Pretend to shine a flashlight.) The jetty light shines again, and the pelican has its own perch!

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and a pelican feather goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Light the harbor]
Then try the bonus game. Go for nine stars.

[ON SCREEN: Next time]
Next time, YOU are the engineer. Start thinking: how could you make light with no plug and no battery?

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
